title: Small perfect well-generators of a Grothendieck derived category
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian category A with v-small derived Hom spaces [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and coproducts [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts], there are a regular kappa in universe v and an essentially v-small shift-closed class G of kappa-small objects satisfying G4 [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object], such that every replete triangulated class closed under v-small coproducts and containing G contains every object of D(A).

source.place: Neeman, On the derived category of sheaves on a manifold, Theorem 0.2 and Section 2; Alonso--Jeremias--Souto, Localization in categories of complexes and unbounded resolutions, Proposition 5.1; Krause (2001), Theorem A, Theorem C and Lemma 4.

proof.text: Use the exact Gabriel--Popescu presentation and its derived exact localization. The source is a compactly generated module derived category.

Generate the localization kernel by the bounded-above torsion free-complex set of Alonso--Jeremias--Souto Proposition 5.1, then use Neeman Theorem 0.2 to obtain small perfect well-generators of the quotient.

Choose a common uncountable regular support bound and close the generating family under smaller coproducts and isomorphisms. Its skeleton is small, support bounds follow from regularity, shifts preserve it, and Krause Lemma 4 gives G4. Its localizing closure is the whole derived category.
